name: WordWar: Amagama esiNgisi 1v1
whatsNew: Okusha ku-1.0.7: thepha noma yimuphi umdlali ebhodini labaphambili ubone izindawo zakhe zosuku, zesonto, zenyanga nezesikhathi sonke, bese umphonsela inselelo yomdlalo we-Classic noma yempi ye-Mystery. Uthola isaziso noma engekho ku-inthanethi. Imiphumela ikhombisa incazelo yegama. Futhi: imisindo yegeyimu nokudlidliza okunamandla kakhulu (setha i-Volume ne-Strength ku-Settings), umbukiso wegeyimu esikrinini sokwamukela, amazinga anzima kakhudlwana nokulungiswa okuningi.
shortDescription: Qhudelana nembangi bukhoma ngegama lesiNgisi elifihliwe. Oshesha uyawina.
description:
Ucabanga ukuthi ushesha ngamagama? Kufakazele — bukhoma.

I-WordWar ingumdlalo wamagama we-1v1 wesikhathi sangempela: wena nembangi yakho nithola igama ELIFANAYO elifihliwe futhi nincintisana newashi elifanayo. Qagela emigqeni yamathayela ezinhlamvu — okuluhlaza kusho uhlamvu olufanele endaweni efanele; okuphuzi kusho uhlamvu olufanele endaweni engafanele. Ubona imibala yamathayela embangi yakho ishintsha ngaso leso sikhathi, kodwa awulokothi ubone izinhlamvu zayo. Owokuqala ukulithola uyawina.

I-WordWar idlalwa ngesiNgisi: wonke amagama, kanye nohlelo lokusebenza ngokwalo, kungesiNgisi — indlela emnandi yokujwayela amagama esiNgisi.

⚔️ IZIMPI ZESIKHATHI SANGEMPELA
Akukho ukushintshana. Bobabili abadlali baxazulula ngasikhathi sinye ngenkathi iwashi lihamba. Funda intuthuko yembangi yakho emibaleni yayo bese uyidlula.

🏆 KHUPHUKA AMAZINGA
Nqoba ukuze ukhuphuke amazinga ayisishiyagalombili — Stone, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, Legend. Umdlalo ngamunye ushintsha i-Elo yakho. Isizini ngayinye iqala kabusha uhlu lwamazinga ukuze noma ubani akhuphuke.

🎮 IZINDLELA EZINE ZOKUDLALA
• Classic Ranked — gijimisana nembangi egameni elifanayo, 1v1
• Mystery Duel — ngamunye uthumela igama bese niqagela elomunye
• Daily Challenge — igama elilodwa lomhlaba wonke, kulinganiswa ngenani lokuqagela
• Friends — imidlalo eyimfihlo ebukhoma ngesimemo noma ngekhodi

⚡ ZUZA AMANDLA ENGEZIWE
Sebenzisa i-Reveal ukuveza uhlamvu, i-Scramble ukuphazamisa isikrini sembangi yakho, noma i-Lock ukukhiya amandla ayo engeziwe. Wazuze ngokudlala, ngokunqoba okulandelanayo nangemiklomelo yansuku zonke.

🎨 KWENZE KUBE NGOKWAKHO
Vula amathimu ebhodi, opopayi bokunqoba, ama-avatar, amapuleti amagama nemingcele yephrofayela. Kukhona nemodi ephelele yabangaboni kahle imibala, enamathayela agqame kakhulu.

📈 LANDELELA KONKE
Izinga lokunqoba, ukunqoba okulandelanayo, umlando wezinga, nokubuka kabusha imidlalo ngokuphelele ukuze ufunde ukuthi impi ngayinye yahamba kanjani.

Kwakhelwe ubulungiswa: impendulo ayilokothi iphume kuseva, konke ukuqagela kuhlolwa futhi kunikezwa amaphuzu kuseva, futhi konke ukulinganisa kubalwa kuseva.

Landa i-WordWar bese uqala impi yakho yokuqala ngemizuzwana.
